title: Starfall Salvage
description: Pilot a small ship through falling asteroid waves, build a run-changing upgrade loadout, and break each sector boss in this portrait mobile arcade shooter.

defaultCaptions.x: Starfall Salvage: dodge the fall, build the ship, break the sector.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Starfall Salvage is a portrait mobile space shooter with falling asteroid waves, upgrade cards, and sector bosses.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I built Starfall Salvage, a one-thumb space survival game where every wave changes the ship build.
defaultCaptions.discord: Starfall Salvage is live: auto-fire, salvage pickups, upgrade cards, elite hazards, and boss sectors.
